newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to sign Nuclear Treaty at U.N..
newsitem.headline: Clinton to sign Nuclear Treaty at U.N..

text.p: President Bill Clinton will sign the Comprehensive Nuclear Test Ban Treaty next week at the United Nations and meet privately with Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, the White House announced on Monday.

"The president will be the first world leader to sign the treaty" at a ceremony on Tuesday, White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry said. Clinton will then address the 51st annual session of the U.N. General Assembly.
After his speech, Clinton will meet Hashimoto to discuss economic and security issues, McCurry said.
